meta.name: pin-record
meta.description: Use when you need to record a single pin entity to the knowledge graph. Invokes lib/pins record() to validate and write a canonical .md file. Triggers on "record pin", "pin this", "save this as a pin".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将当前内容记录到知识图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要快速保存碎片信息
copy.tagline_en: Save current content to the knowledge graph
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly capture snippets

howto.what: Claude 可以记录单个实体到知识图谱，生成规范的 .md 文件，并自动验证、原子写入，可选 Git 提交。
howto.when: 当你说“record pin”、“pin this”或“save this as a pin”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 把这篇文章保存为一个pin
say.note: Claude会请求你提供实体信息并生成pin文件

say.text: 记录一个关于我的项目的pin
say.note: Claude会引导你填写实体详情

howto.what_en: Claude can record a single entity to the knowledge graph, generate a canonical .md file with validation and atomic write, and optionally commit to Git.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "record pin", "pin this", or "save this as a pin".

say_en.text: Save this article as a pin
say_en.note: Claude will ask for entity info and generate the pin file

say_en.text: Record a pin about my project
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to fill in entity details
